title: 🤝 PFRDA Strategic Panels — M.S. Sahoo Assured Payout Committee & SAARG Investment Review
summary: PFRDA constituted 15-member advisory committee chaired by Dr. M.S. Sahoo for guaranteed payouts under NPS, and SAARG panel chaired by Narayan Ramachandran for NPS investment governance.

blocks.content: **Overview**: PFRDA constituted 15-member advisory committee chaired by Dr. M.S. Sahoo for guaranteed payouts under NPS, and SAARG panel chaired by Narayan Ramachandran for NPS investment governance.

items: **PFRDA Sets Up M.S. Sahoo Committee on Assured Payouts & SAARG Investment Panel** (Page 150): PFRDA constituted 15-member advisory committee chaired by Dr. M.S. Sahoo for guaranteed payouts under NPS, and SAARG panel chaired by Narayan Ramachandran for NPS investment governance.

**IRDAI Reconstitutes Reinsurance Advisory Committee (RAC) Under A.V. Girija Kumar** (Page 151): IRDAI reconstituted Reinsurance Advisory Committee under Section 101B of Insurance Act 1938 for 3-year term chaired by former OICL CMD A.V. Girija Kumar.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Pension Regulatory Reforms & Governance Panels. PFRDA 15-member Sahoo committee for assured NPS payouts and SAARG panel under Narayan Ramachandran for investment guidelines.
